stem_md: 设 $z=e^{-(1/x+1/y)}$，则下列结论错误的是(\quad)。
analysis_md: $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{e^{-(\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y})}}{x^2}，\quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{e^{-(\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y})}}{y^2}$，则 $x^2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y^2\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=2z，\quad \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x^2}=\frac{(1-2x)e^{-(\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y})}}{x^4}，\quad \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial y^2}=\frac{(1-2y)e^{-(\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y})}}{y^4}，\quad \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{e^{-(\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y})}}{x^2y^2}$
